details.body:
Do not access the byeways when the red flags are flying and the danger signs (‘live firing’ or ‘no public entry’) are displayed.

For your own safety do not touch any military debris, it may be dangerous.

Learn more about accessing MOD training areas safely.

Related information

  • Public access and location: Salisbury Plain
  • Salisbury Plain Training Area (SPTA) newsletter
  • The Defence Training Estate: south west including Salisbury Plain
  • Salisbury Plain public information leaflet
  • Low flying in your area
  • Salisbury Plain (Imber Range Perimeter Path)
